Case note: R.C.A. No. 2573/2025
Client: Varun Rao (chartered accountant, New Delhi)
Opposing party: Aarti Kurian
Court: New Delhi District Court
Filed on: 09/08/2025
Claim amount: INR 2,20,000/-
Issue: tenancy eviction. The tenant has sublet the flat without permission.
Advice given: Collect evidence of unauthorised subletting such as utility bills in the occupant's name.
Outcome: The tenant admitted the subletting and agreed to vacate.
Recommended next step: Record the compromise before the court.
Witness: Meera Tiwari
